source.Title: Pulse Demon
source.Review: While I consider myself a fan of noise music, I still require certain elements to form an emotional attachment. Regrettably, I personally find no organic or nuanced qualities in this particular work. In contrast, the later album Hyperbrid Noisebloom utilizes noise to reconstruct natural or atmospheric sounds, while maintaining the tension with harshness, which I find myself drawn to and deeply appreciative of. Pulse Demon offers no respite or subtlety instead, subjecting the listener to a relentless assault on the senses that ultimately leads to an experience of only agony and distress.
source.Review Title: If only there's more nuance to it

source.Title: Filth
source.Review:
The album's title and cover art capture the listening experience precisely, as if the listener is being torn apart and devoured by the ferocious beasts of sound. The themes of filth and force violently collide, producing sparks that set ablaze a gruesome scene.

Michael's frenzied growling vocals, the raw and scratchy guitar and bass riffs, and the solid, heavy beats of the drums, all detonate with tremendous force. Noise persistent, instruments distorted to be "filthy", yet the soundscape mananges to avoid becoming a jumbled mess; instead it soars and pierces through. Every individual sound element is executed with precision and balance, leaving enough space for each other, resulting in a rather clear and easy-to-listen-to mix compared with other works in this genre.
source.Review Title: A Blazing Collision of Filth and Force

source.Title: Whitenoise Superstar
source.Review:
The primal form of noise is a full-band white noise, which can be harsh and numbing, requiring equalization to attain more soothing brown or pink noise. Despite featuring a continuous barrage of white noise, this album presents a texture that flows like waves, constantly sweeping and splashing, or like waves of sunlight that soak the listener completely. 

It truly transforms the very essence of white noise into a truly unique artistic experience, where white noise is both the leading role and foundation, with every other layer of sound seamlessly bleeding into it. This is not simply a shoe-gazing approach of layering effects from bottom up in an attempt to incorprate diverse yet cohesive sounds, maybe resulting in a texture that is reminiscent of white noise. Rather, it is more of a creative process that works in reverse: it aims solely at the white noise, retains its nature, builds everything around it, and ultimately nails the execution.

source.Title: Emergent Errors
source.Review:
Tegh's music is an extraordinary fusion of the raw and primitive with the futuristic and refined. The desolate and spacious ambience creates a haunting soundscape, where blocky industrial noise infuses sharp and abrupt sensory impacts, evoking the image of a towering machine roaring, running, and collapsing in an apocalyptic scenario. In contrast, delicate and silky electronic tones transmit messages like electric waves, broadcasting digital signals to the universe, subtly emerging from the endless waves of ambient sound.

The organic arrangements of the strings and other acoustic instruments intertwine with the electric and industrial sounds, creating a seamless integration that mirrors the inseparable entanglement of human sense and sensibility, or a clash between primitive civilization and future technology, reminiscent of retro-futurism. Each track feels like a solemn elegy for the demise of a civilization, tribe, or life, where Tegh masterfully weaves together a musical narrative that captures the essence of this profound loss.

Overall, Tegh's album is a remarkable and inventive work of art that showcases a rare talent for blending contrasting musical styles into a cohesive and poignant expression of emotion and creativity.

source.Title: The leaver and the left
source.Review:
Top-notch experience from start to finish. The somber atmosphere is balanced by lively electronic instruments, with unpredictable chord progressions both melancholic and intriguing. Unconventional section arrangements allow instruments and sound effects to develop freely and really shine throughout.

The tension and atmosphere are amplified by rich and emotionally nuanced strings, smooth piano passages that flow like water, and a variety of samples and effects that enhance the overall texture. The lyrics are sparse and continuously evolving rather than repetitive, and the English vocals with a touch of French flair are quite a delight.

Every track is a full of memorable moments, making for a top-notch listening experience.
source.Review Title: Quite a hidden gem, rich in emotion and diverse in soundscape
